s: Profiling, benchmarking, N+1 queries, memory leaks, caching
d: Performance is a feature. Profiling finds bottlenecks, benchmarking proves improvements. Know how to optimize database queries, reduce memory usage, minimize latency, and use caching effectively. Always measure before optimizing.

p: Performance is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
